decisions.reason: Although the firm has some innovative slack, a vegan superfood drink mix sits relatively far from its core industrial technology business, so if early results are merely ambiguous management is likely to reallocate resources to more central ventures.

Modular waste-to-energy plant extensions fit the established offer closely, and in a growing industry with hiring and active R&D the firm has little immediate reason to search away from such a core-adjacent product.

A waste oil to energy plant is strongly aligned with the firm's main capabilities and the dedicated product page suggests commitment, so under behavioral-theory logic it is likely to be retained unless results clearly disappoint.

The plastic waste to fuel plant is strategically close to the firm's circular-technology base and likely worth continuing under available slack, though its adjacent fit and higher uncertainty make it somewhat more droppable than the most established core offerings.
